notices.tajGuide: Inside the Taj Mahal a guide is NOT allowed alongside a photographer. On photography packages your licensed photographer is with you inside; on guide + photo tours the guide covers Agra Fort, Mehtab Bagh and Itmad-ud-Daulah, and the photographer takes you through the Taj Mahal.
notices.tajGuideShort: Inside the Taj Mahal a guide is NOT allowed alongside a photographer. Your photographer is with you inside the Taj; the guide covers Agra Fort, Mehtab Bagh and Itmad-ud-Daulah.

tickets: Monument entry tickets are not included in any package. Taj Mahal entry is about ₹50 for Indian nationals and about ₹1,300 for foreign nationals, plus ₹200 to enter the main mausoleum. Rates are set by the ASI and can change.
terms: All prices are per package — not per person.
20% advance confirms the booking; the balance is paid after the tour.
Every package is customisable — tell us what you want changed and we re-quote.
The official photography permit is included in every photography package.
The Taj Mahal is closed to visitors on Fridays.
Payment: UPI, bank transfer, card or PayPal. Balance in INR, USD, EUR or GBP.
